messages:
Ravi: Quick design huddle  new mocks for roles matrix + invite flow. Main asks: compact role density, clearer seat language, and an inline 'preview-as-user' in the hover card so admins can see effective perms. Figma: https://redwood.ai/figma/rbac-preview-v1

June: Preview-as-user is neat. Thought: add a tiny avatar/dropdown in the hover card to switch context (you, member, viewer). That helps show inherited perms. Keep it keyboard-accessible (enter to open).

Olivia: UX copy note: we've been using "Seats" in headers; research shows admins expect "Seats" = license pool. Suggest renaming to "Assigned seats" and add a secondary label "(active users)" for clarity when space allows.

Mark: Accessibility nit: invite drawer focus management still broken in current build. Steps: open drawer -> tab through inputs -> open SSO options -> hit Esc -> focus lands outside drawer. Fix: ensure close button is first tabbable and trap focus with a focus sentinel. Also add aria-modal="true" on the drawer container.

A11yBot: Automated check: color contrast for SSO badge fails in light mode when using primary-yellow token (contrast 3.7:1). Recommend using brand-ink or darker yellow token. Also flag: all actionable badges need keyboard focus styles.

Ravi: Good catch. We'll switch badge color and add :focus-visible styles.

June: Microcopy debate for SSO states (need small variants):
- enforced (long): "This organization enforces SSO. Invited users must authenticate with your SSO provider."
- enforced (short): "SSO enforced  sign-in via your SSO required."
- optional: "SSO available. Users may sign in with SSO or email."
Which should be used where? My take: use long on modals/confirm screens, short on compact table cells.

Olivia: Agree. Also propose we show an icon + badge in the roles grid when a role comes from an SSO policy (tooltip: "Linked to SSO policy: <policy-name>"). Tooltip should be keyboard-openable (aria-haspopup + aria-expanded).

Mark: Invite flow nuance: for bulk CSV invites, add a "dry run" preview mode that validates rows and shows proposed role mapping before actually sending. Show per-row status and inline fixes. CSV sample header: `email,role_slug,expires_at` and example rows in a code block.

```
email,role_slug,expires_at
sam@example.com,team-frontend,2026-07-01
lee@example.com,team-ops,
```

Olivia: Nice. Also add a small inline copy: "Expires_at format: YYYY-MM-DD or empty for never."

A11yBot: Screen reader flow: toasts must use role="status" and aria-live="polite"; don't auto-dismiss until announced. QA has seen missed announcements when toasts auto-hide in <3s. Recommend 6s or persistent until user dismisses when using assistive tech.

Ravi: We'll make toasts adaptable: default 4s, but extend to 8s if `prefers-reduced-motion` or if `aria-hidden` detection indicates a screen reader.

June: Quick keyboard shortcut proposal for power users: `g r` -> roles grid, `g i` -> invite drawer, `g a` -> audit. Show a subtle keyboard hint in the top-left (small pill) after first use. Thoughts?

Mark: +1. For audit nav, propose left/right arrow to step through events and `[` / `]` to jump pages. Also add sticky filters so reviewers don't lose selected filters while paging.

Olivia: Audit microcopy: in the event details panel, replace vague verbs with explicit ones. Eg. instead of "updated role", use "role 'team-ops' permissions changed by Maya". Add `policy_id` and `template_id` tokens in the event payload so filters are easier.

PatchBot: Dev note: API changes required - invites endpoint needs `dry_run` boolean, `expires_at` nullable string, and server should return `row_errors` for CSV upload. PR: https://git.redwood/infra/pr/912

Mark: Small UI suggestion: give roles color tags (muted swatches) to help scanning; ensure they are decorational only (use aria-hidden) and include text label for colorblind users. Also provide a high-contrast toggle in Settings for reviewers.

A11yBot: Confirm: color tags must have text fallback and not be the only means of conveying role importance. Also test in simulated deuteranopia.

Ravi: Action items: 1) update mocks with preview-as-user avatar switch + hover/keyboard expand, 2) rename Seats -> Assigned seats (with optional '(active users)'), 3) fix focus order + aria-modal on drawer, 4) adjust SSO badge color + focus style, 5) add CSV dry-run UI copy + example, 6) implement toast ARIA changes, 7) keyboard shortcuts mapping, 8) audit stepping arrows + sticky filters. I'll post updated Figma and a condensed spec for engineering later today. Thanks all :sparkles:
